entry.title: MPC Multihead Echo 1.0.3
entry.summary: Two visible fixes, one honesty fix. **Companion page: the tape heads were not centred.** They were mapped from the raw delay ratios onto the whole ribbon, so the first third of the tape stayed empty and all three heads were pushed right. entry.title: MPC Multihead Echo 1.0.2
entry.summary: `url` and `PAIR` in `/state`, a **pairing QR** at `/qr.svg` (tap the PAIR line in the panel), and the write-header check is case-insensitive now — a browser that sends `x-mhe: 1` in lower case was refused with "missing X-MHE header" while curl worked. The QR encodes this listener's address, so a second phone can join by scanning instead of typing. Encoder: Project Nayuki's qrcodegen (MIT), vendored with notice.

entry.title: MPC Multihead Echo 1.0.1
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo as a native MPC-OS VST2 effect. **Install:** unzip, then `./install.sh` on the device as root (stops MPC, backs up `MPC.settings`, restarts it) — or follow `INSTALL.md` for the manual path. **Verified:** MPC Live II, MPC OS 3.9.1.2 (AZ0x 5.0.17), 2026-10-31 — loads, plays, saves with a project; 9 presets in the PRESET menu; companion screen used from a phone on the LAN. **Bench** (Gen1 armv7): worst p99 **24.4 %** of the 2902 µs block, worst block 26.2 %, the companion liste
